env_vars.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
env_vars.purpose: Server-only service role for cron + agent_logs writes (TODO).

env_vars.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: Transactional email for intro accept (TODO not yet wired).

env_vars.name: JUMPSTART_FORCE_STUBS
env_vars.purpose: Force local heuristics even with real keys.

env_vars.name: JUMPSTART_ALLOW_STUB
env_vars.purpose: Allow deterministic dev session (the only stub auth gate).

env_vars.name: JUMPSTART_PRIVATE_BETA
env_vars.purpose: Allow in-memory rate-limit fallback in prod + dev-admin pair.

frontend_routes.summary: Landing: hero, AnimatedCounter, FounderPass preview, CohortGlobe.
Email + LinkedIn entry. Currently mock localStorage; real magic link not yet wired.
Step 1: name, age, city, oneLine, publicLink.
Step 2: founder card editor (4 fields). Synthesizes local card and sets next eligible drop.
Step 3: tags + intent multi-select. Hardcoded questions today.
Step 4: phone OTP + ticket photo. Client-local stub OTP.
Curated match delivery + countdown. Today reads from local-drop.ts; will consume POST /api/drops.
Match detail + intro request modal. POSTs to /api/intros.
Forum-style posts (Show, Ask, Feedback, Hiring, Other) over localStorage.
Post detail + thread view.
Tabbed inbox: requests, active, sent (localStorage).
Thread conversation view.
Founder Pass + edit + sign out.
Public read-only Founder Pass. Calls GET /api/browse?id=.
Admin hub. Layout calls getAdmin().
Live dependency probe (polls /api/health every 4s).
Manual match curation.
Moderation queue.
Agent invocation logs.
Cohort analytics.
